# Southern Strolls

Southern Strolls is a premium, professional pet care and dog walking service based in Lafayette, Louisiana, serving Youngsville, Lafayette, Broussard, and Scott. Owned and operated by Karlee Kitchen, the company offers routine-based daytime pet care, private dog walking, and pet taxi services.

## Contact Information
- **Owner:** Karlee Kitchen
- **Email:** southernstrollsla@gmail.com
- **Phone:** (318) 955-5947
- **Website:** https://southernstrolls.la
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/southernstrollsla
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/people/Southern-Strolls/61585024023710/
- **Client Portal (TimeToPet):** https://www.timetopet.com/portal/southernstrolls

## Operating Hours
- **Regular Daytime Care:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM
- **Pet Transportation:** Monday–Friday, 6:30 AM – 6:30 PM (Subject to availability)
- *Note: Overnight services and late-night visits are not offered.*

## Site Structure & Pages

### 1. Home Page (/)
- General introduction, packages, benefits, basic policies, and highlights of our services.

### 2. About Us (/about)
- Professional bio of owner Karlee Kitchen.
- Explains our focus on trust, reliability, safety, and personalized pet routines.
- Highlights membership in the **International Boarding & Pet Services Association (IBPSA)** representing quality standards in the pet services industry.

### 3. Testimonials (/testimonials)
- Verified client reviews from local pet parents (Golden Retrievers, French Bulldogs, Persian Cats, German Shepherds, etc.) highlighting the "Southern Standard" of care.

### 4. Core Services (/services/:serviceId)
We offer 4 dedicated services:
- **Drop-In Visit (30 min)** (`/services/drop-in-30`)
  - **Price:** $23 / visit (+ $10 extra pet)
  - **Details:** Maintaining your pet's exact daily routine (feeding, potty break, litter clean, play, oral meds, and real-time updates with photos).
- **Dog Walking** (`/services/dog-walking`)
  - **Price:** $25 (30 min) / $45 (60 min)
  - **Details:** 100% private, individual walks in your neighborhood tailored to your dog's pace. Includes post-walk paw cleaning, water refills, and GPS tracking reports.
- **Quick Drop In Visits** (`/services/quick-drop-in`)
  - **Price:** $17 (1 stop) / $30 (2 stops)
  - **Details:** Efficient 15-minute check-ins. Great for senior dogs, puppy potty breaks, or independent cats. Stackable options are available.
- **Pet Transportation** (`/services/pet-transportation`)
  - **Price:** $25 (One-way) / $45 (Round-trip)
  - **Details:** Safe, climate-controlled, and secure taxi service for local vet or grooming appointments (up to 30 min per leg). Includes assistance with destination check-ins.

## Service Philosophy
We operate under "The Southern Standard"—treating every companion with uncompromised safety, tailored affection, and maintaining clear communication with pet parents via our portal.
